name: After § 64
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 64a. Recognises the continuing contribution of Christianity to European societies and to the values of human dignity, solidarity, responsibility and service to the community; encourages the post-2027 EU Youth Strategy to create space for young people to engage with Europe’s Christian tradition as a source of identity, belonging and civic responsibility, in full respect of freedom of religion or belief;
